name: reg-reporting-toolkit
description: A multi-agent regulatory intelligence pipeline for Swiss and EU reporting regimes — six jurisdiction-isolated SME subagents (FMIA Art 39, FMIA Art 104, EMIR, MiFIR Transaction Reporting, MiFID II Client Classification, FinSA Client Segmentation) feeding a comparison, convergence, output-quality and executive reporting chain, with citation discipline and an auditable trail.
